title: Ireland (ISD) visa-required nationalities, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 map

source.publisher: Immigration Service Delivery (ISD), Department of Justice, Ireland
source.data_endpoint_note: The nationality table on the source page is a Ninja Tables AJAX table (id 19077) whose rows are served from the same irishimmigration.ie origin by this endpoint. Saved verbatim in source_isd_visa-non-visa-required-nationalities.txt.

applies_to: Short stay 'C' visa (visits of 90 days or less)
Long stay 'D' visa (stays of more than 90 days)
scope.note: ISD publishes a single visa-required / non-visa-required nationality list that governs both the short stay 'C' and long stay 'D' routes; the requirement is set by nationality, not by visa class.
caveats: visa_required reflects nationality only. The ISD page lists separate exemptions that override it for an individual: a valid Irish Residence Permit, an Irish-issued Travel Document, an Article 10 'Residence card of a family member of a Union citizen', and the under-16 temporary suspension. This dataset does not model those exemptions.
Refugee and stateless applicants are keyed by the country that issued their travel document, not by nationality. ISD's 'Refugee or Stateless*' row is carried in unmapped_entries.

TIME-LIMITED DETERMINATION: the 'Refugee or Stateless*' row is not a standing rule. It rests on Ireland's temporary suspension of the European Agreement on the Abolition of Visas for Refugees, which the ISD page states applies 'as of 12 noon on 19 July' 'for a period of 12 months' WITHOUT naming a year. The Department of Justice press release that the ISD page links to records the suspension as introduced in July 2022 and extended on a rolling 12-month review basis since, so the end of the current window CANNOT be derived from the saved source text and must not be guessed. Re-verify this row against the ISD page before relying on it. No country-level ISO 3166-1 determination in this dataset depends on it.
Libya (LY) carries an ISD '**' footnote: additional restrictions apply to which categories of Libyan visa application are considered.

temporary_provision.instrument: European Agreement on the Abolition of Visas for Refugees
temporary_provision.isd_wording: As of 12 noon on 19 July, Ireland is temporarily suspending operation of the European Agreement on the Abolition of Visas for Refugees for a period of 12 months.
